content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chandler

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of experience. Verify you meet these education and experience thresholds before enrolling. Chandler's semiconductor and electronics sectors value PMP credentials—confirming eligibility now ensures you're ready to move forward.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Over several weeks, you'll learn project-management frameworks, risk strategies, and real-world applications through interactive sessions. Our flexible schedule accommodates working professionals in Chandler's tech-driven industries. All instruction is online, so you train from your location.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. This formal registration authorizes you to schedule your exam. Most applications are processed within days.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and final review sessions—to reinforce course content and build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a testing center. Dedicated preparation increases your readiness for this rigorous, professional assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by completing training, volunteering, or publishing work related to project management. Before expiration, renew your credential by submitting your accumulated PDUs to PMI. Staying current keeps your certification active and demonstrates ongoing expertise.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
